# TeslaExtra v0.3.0 - Table of Contents

Additional Tesla middleware

## Modules

- [TeslaExtra.EncodeURI](https://tesla-extra.hexdocs.pm/TeslaExtra.EncodeURI.md): Ensures that the URI is properly encoded.

- [TeslaExtra.Extend](https://tesla-extra.hexdocs.pm/TeslaExtra.Extend.md): A Tesla plug for extending another Tesla client.
- [TeslaExtra.OptionalPlug](https://tesla-extra.hexdocs.pm/TeslaExtra.OptionalPlug.md): A Tesla plug that wraps another plug, allowing it to be de/activated dynamically.
- [TeslaExtra.RateLimit](https://tesla-extra.hexdocs.pm/TeslaExtra.RateLimit.md): Rate limit middleware for Tesla using Hammer

- [TeslaExtra.RetryAfter](https://tesla-extra.hexdocs.pm/TeslaExtra.RetryAfter.md): Obeys the Retry-After header returned by the server when the rate limit is exceeded.

- [TeslaExtra.RuntimeOpts](https://tesla-extra.hexdocs.pm/TeslaExtra.RuntimeOpts.md): A Tesla plug that wraps another plug, allowing it to be configured with
options which are evaluated on each call.
- [TeslaExtra.WithRequestId](https://tesla-extra.hexdocs.pm/TeslaExtra.WithRequestId.md): Adds a randomly generated request ID to the headers and request options.
